content: better-auth Prisma adapter: import prismaAdapter from 'better-auth/adapters/prisma' (bundled in core better-auth package per project CLAUDE.md), pass prisma client + {provider:'postgresql'}. A separate @better-auth/prisma-adapter npm package (v1.6.23, official better-auth maintainers, published within the last week) now also exists on the registry -- flagged as an open question for implementation-time verification since it conflicts with CLAUDE.md's locked guidance to use the bundled import path. Prisma 7 custom generator output path requires importing PrismaClient from that path, not bare @prisma/client, in both db.ts and the auth config.
